items.description: Laptop accidental damage repair (screen and lower-right corner), settled with shop
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.2 (swerve in conveyance) and 2.6.3 (screen and corner = one loss on one unit); direct settlement under 7.1.12 doesn't change cover. Reference cases put screen plus corner repair at about 1150-1170 EUR; no deductible or sub-limit stated.
